prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 4 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, soft daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows.
Image 1: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S0
Image 2: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 3: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 4: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 7: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 8: the prop pour-over coffee equipment; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut executive desk, which is centred in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows. She faces the front pin-up wall, with the high-backed black leather chair behind her. She wears the fitted dove-grey silk shirt and the black bodycon pencil skirt. She holds the black gooseneck kettle over the glass V60 dripper, which sits on its glass server at the pour-over station on the desk. The white coffee cup sits on its saucer beside the station. The desktop also holds spread architectural plans, a fan of wood samples and the small brushed-metal figurine. Camera side: in front of the desk, on the pin-up wall side, facing the desk and the windows.
Panel 1: Wide shot, fast push in, eye level, from the pin-up wall facing the desk and the windows. The sleek office with the city skyline behind the glass. Ji Ran stands behind the walnut desk among the plans and wood samples, pouring a thin stream from the black kettle into the dripper. Her lips stay closed.
Panel 2: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, high angle, from the front of the desk looking down at the pour-over station. Ji Ran's hand circles the gooseneck kettle, and the water spirals over the coffee grounds in the glass dripper.
Panel 3: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front of the desk. Ji Ran sets the kettle down and braces one hand flat on the desk beside the plans. Her mouth stays closed and her expression turns cold.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, slight push in, low angle, from the front of the desk. Ji Ran lifts her eyes toward the pin-up wall with a flat, icy half-smile, her hand still braced on the desk.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
